first.text:
Draft's written at `.coach/drafts/2026-11-04-program-2.toml`, a copy of pv-3. I'll make two edits before the dry run:

1. Add a fifth line to `mon-ohp`: Incline Curl (Dumbbell), 3 sets of 8 to 12 at RPE 8, double progression, 60 s rest, after the rear delt flys. I'll leave the lateral raise and rear delt fly superset as it is and keep the curl on its own, so you're not supersetting a biceps lift into a shoulder pair you already run tight.
2. Rewrite `because`, since the current text explains pv-3's engine change, not this one. It'll say: direct biceps work was six sets on one day; an incline curl on Monday takes it to nine sets over two days, at long muscle length, with the curl last so the biceps get the full gap since Sunday.

Kind stays `amend`: same split, same emphasis, one session changed.

Then I run `coach program adopt --dry-run` and come back with what it shows: the diff against pv-3, the incline curl's start load from your Hevy history with its kg, Monday's time estimate against the 75-minute cap, and any warnings. Nothing is recorded until you say yes to those numbers.
